annotations.text: MY SUBSCRIPTION — redesigned as the "Punya Bank" passbook: accumulated punya at the top, then exactly what ₹399 (गृह शांति) includes, a bahi-khata ledger with WhatsApp proof, Ashirwad Patra, family sankalp.
HOME — a subscriber lands on a warm "welcome back" banner: active status, this-month sevas, next seva date, and one clear button into My Subscription.
SUBSCRIBED STATE — how the active-membership cue appears across the app: header, plans page, profile, and the collapsed home banner.
